reasoning_content: MapLocation now uses mappable polymorphic. investment_id column may not exist. Let me fix that.

action.command:
cd /workspace; python3 - <<'PY'
p="db/dev_seeds/budgets.rb"
s=open(p).read()
old='''      MapLocation.create(latitude: Setting["map.latitude"].to_f + rand(-10..10) / 100.to_f,
                         longitude: Setting["map.longitude"].to_f + rand(-10..10) / 100.to_f,
                         zoom: Setting["map.zoom"],
                         investment_id: investment.id)'''
new='''      MapLocation.create(latitude: Setting["map.latitude"].to_f + rand(-10..10) / 100.to_f,
                         longitude: Setting["map.longitude"].to_f + rand(-10..10) / 100.to_f,
                         zoom: Setting["map.zoom"],
                         mappable: investment)'''
assert old in s
s=s.replace(old,new,1)
open(p,"w").write(s)
print("patched")
PY
